models.name: csma
models.full-name: IEEE 802.3 CSMA/CD (Carrier Sense, Multiple Access with Collision Detection) protocol
models.notes: Number of stations is fixed at N=2.

properties.name: collisions
properties.description: Maximum probability that transmissions from stations collide COL times

models.name: csma_abst
models.full-name: IEEE 802.3 CSMA/CD (Carrier Sense, Multiple Access with Collision Detection) protocol (abstract model)
models.notes: Number of stations is fixed at N=2.

properties.name: deadline_max
properties.description: Maximum probability that both stations have sent their packets within time T

properties.name: deadline_min
properties.description: Minimum probability that both stations have sent their packets within time T

properties.name: eventually
properties.description: Minimum probability that both stations eventually send their packets

models.name: firewire

params.name: delay
params.description: maximum wire transmission delay, in units of 10ns

models.notes: PTA model from [KNS03b] based on TA model from [SS01].

properties.name: deadline
properties.description: Minimum probability that a leader has been elected by time T

properties.name: eventually
properties.description: Minimum probability that a leader is eventually elected

models.name: firewire_abst
models.full-name: IEEE 1394 FireWire root contention protocol (abstract model)

params.name: delay
params.description: maximum wire transmission delay, in units of 10ns

models.notes: PTA model from [KNS03b] based on manual abstraction from [SV99].

properties.name: deadline_max
properties.description: Maximum probability that a leader has been elected by time T

properties.name: deadline_min
properties.description: Minimum probability that a leader has been elected by time T

properties.name: eventually
properties.description: Minimum probability that a leader is eventually elected

models.name: repudiation_honest
models.notes: The protocol is due to Markowitch & Roggeman [MR99].

properties.name: deadline
properties.description: Minimum probability that the protocol terminates successfully before time T

properties.name: eventually
properties.description: Minimum probability that the protocol eventually terminates successfully

models.name: repudiation_malicious
models.notes: The protocol is due to Markowitch & Roggeman [MR99].

properties.name: deadline
properties.description: Maximum probability that the malicious recipient gains information before time T

properties.name: eventually
properties.description: Maximum probability that the malicious recipient eventually gains information

properties.name: deadline
properties.description: Maximum probability of configuring IP address incorrectly by time T

properties.description: Maximum probability of configuring IP address incorrectly
